name: The footprint of climate oscillations in global inland waters
description: Reproducible R analysis quantifying and explaining how ENSO, IOD and NAO explain interannual temperature variability in global rivers and lakes (surface and bottom), 1950-2021, via the oscillation footprint F (adjusted R-squared of detrended water temperature on the three season-specific indices), with two-block variation partitioning of direct vs mediated pathways.
